$comment: event_cards are the Night of the Wererabbit gear (Gear.json entries 46-72, added after the shipped 45, which tools/build_gear_data.py does not touch); tools/pack_gear_atlas.py packs cards then event_cards. Subject line and backdrop for every Gear.json entry. The style portion of the prompt is the equipment card block in ARTSTYLE.md; LOCATION in that block is replaced by this entry's backdrop. gear_index is the 1-based position in game/data/Gear.json; frame is the items_gear atlas frame the card is packed into.
